selectSkills: Select skills and choose where to install them.
readSource: Read SKILL.md files together with their scripts and references.
localPathHint: Paste a local path or choose a file
rememberSource: Remember this repository for future installations
personalHint: Personal skills apply to local tasks. Project skills apply only in their code directory.
pickerFailed: Could not open the picker. Retry or paste a path.
previewFailed: Could not read skills. Check the source, access and SKILL.md.
installFailed: Installation failed. Existing skills will not be overwritten.
loadFailed: Could not load. Select Refresh to retry.
skillDiscoveryErrors: Could not parse {{count}} skills. Check their SKILL.md files and refresh.
removeFailed: Could not remove the skill files. Refresh and retry.
removed: Uninstalled. New tasks will use the updated skills.
installed: Installed. Manage its enabled state in the list.
skillsDescription: Add reusable workflows to your tasks.
noSkills: No skills in this scope. Install from Git or import local files.
removeSkillConfirm: Uninstalling {{name}} removes its local directory and contents. Its source repository is unchanged.
serverNameHint: Use letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores. The name remains unchanged after adding.
nameInvalid: Invalid name, or a server with that name already exists.
urlInvalid: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without embedded credentials.
jsonInvalid: Arguments must be a JSON array of strings. Environment must be a JSON object with string values and valid variable names.
saveFailed: Could not save. Check the configuration and retry.
tokenEnvHint: Enter the variable name in the runtime environment, not the token itself.
tokenEnvInvalid: Enter a valid environment variable name.
connectHint: Connect after saving. If OAuth is required, select Sign in in the server list.
statusFailed: Configuration loaded, but connection status is unavailable. Refresh to retry.
reloadFailed: Configuration is saved, but connections could not reload. Select Refresh to retry.
loginOpened: Sign-in page opened. After signing in, select Refresh to check the connection.
loginFailed: Could not start sign-in. Check server authentication settings and retry.
mcpDescription: Connect company services and use their tools in tasks.
noTools: No tools yet. Check the connection and refresh.
mcpScopeHint: Manage this user’s local configuration. Existing tasks depend on runtime reload; new tasks use the latest configuration.
removeServerConfirm: Remove local configuration for {{name}}. The server itself will not be deleted.
